title: Expression of Interest - Behavioural Scientists and Leaders, Multiple Opportunities
description:
Expression of Interest - Behavioural Scientists and Leaders, Multiple Opportunities 
 Apply Behavioural Science and experimentation to improve financial wellbeing at scale
 Join an established team working with leading researchers and specialist teams
 Explore multiple opportunities across applied behavioural science, experimentation, and leadership
 Do work that matters 
 The CommBank Behavioural Science Centre of Excellence uses applied behavioural science and experimentation to design better financial services. We study how people decide and behave in real financial contexts, combine theory with current scientific evidence, and use those insights to develop, test and improve services for customers, colleagues and communities.
 We are growing our Behavioural Science Centre of Excellence and inviting expressions of interest from behavioural scientists, experimentation specialists and behavioural science leaders. We have multiple opportunities across applied behavioural science and experimentation, with appointments reflecting each candidate's technical depth, applied experience and leadership scope. Whether your strength is delivering rigorous research, building experimentation capability or leading a portfolio of work, we would like to hear from you.
 Our work addresses important behavioural challenges in financial services, including financial wellbeing, the psychology of scams and fraud, and best practice in human-centred AI.
 See yourself in our team 
 Established in 2016, our specialist team works with leading Australian and international researchers and with colleagues across product, technology, strategy and customer experience. Together, we deliver practical innovation, rigorous research and measurable customer, community and business outcomes.
 Our shared foundation across the team is that we frame important behavioural problems, synthesise evidence, design rigorous research and translate findings into practical recommendations. Candidates may bring depth in one of the following streams or strengths across both.
 Key roles and streams of work: 
 We will consider your experience across applied delivery, technical depth, leadership and portfolio scope to identify the opportunity that best matches your strengths.
 Senior Associate: independently deliver well-scoped behavioural science, research or experimentation projects.
 Behavioural Scientist: lead complex engagements and influence product and service decisions.
 Senior Behavioural Scientist: shape portfolios, develop people and advise senior leaders.
 Applied behavioural science 
 Frame behavioural problems and synthesise relevant theory and evidence
 Design research and translate insights into practical customer, colleague or service interventions
 Partner with product, risk, technology, strategy and customer teams to influence decisions
 Experimentation and analytics 
 Design and analyse lab, field and quasi-experimental studies
 Provide guidance on experimental design, causal inference and statistical analysis
 Build reusable experimentation standards, tools and capability across the organisation
 Key responsibilities: 
 Deliver applied projects from problem framing and evidence synthesis through to design, analysis and recommendation
 Identify high-value opportunities to improve customer, community, colleague or business outcomes
 Design, oversee and interpret rigorous research, experiments or surveys
 Use AI tools carefully and rigorously to improve research quality, speed, scale and impact
 Translate behavioural evidence into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives
 Influence senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams to apply behavioural science in decisions and services
 Coach colleagues and help lift the quality, clarity and impact of the team's work
 We are interested to hear from people with: 
 Applied experience using behavioural science, experimentation or research to solve real-world problems within consulting, government, academia, financial services or another applied setting.
 Capability in research design, evidence synthesis, analysis and interpretation
 Ability to translate evidence into practical recommendations and measurable outcomes
 Experience partnering with multidisciplinary teams and influencing decisions
 Ability to communicate complex research clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
 Evidence of delivering complex work independently or leading others, depending on the opportunity
 Additional skills and qualifications: 
 We value different career paths and perspectives. If you bring relevant behavioural science, experimentation or applied research experience but do not meet every single requirement listed, we will still encourage you to apply.
 Experimental or quasi-experimental design and causal inference
 Statistical analysis using R, Python or comparable tools
 Reproducible analysis, reusable code or experimentation standards
 An advanced degree in behavioural science, behavioural economics, psychology, cognitive science, economics or a related field is preferred. 
 Relevant professional experience applying behavioural science, experimentation, or research methods is also valued.
 For international candidates, visa sponsorship may be considered only for applicants whose specialist experience is difficult to source locally.
 Working with us: 
 Our people bring their diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives to build a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace. We are working hard to recruit people who represent the diversity of our customers and our society. If you're excited about this opportunity but you don't meet every single requirement, or your experience doesn't align perfectly, we still want to encourage you to send in your application. You may just be the perfect candidate for another opportunity within CommBank.
 At CommBank we will inspire you with work that makes a difference, surrounds you with talented people that respect and value each other, and empower you to grow professionally and personally. Most of all, making a positive impact for customers, communities and each other is part of our every day.
 We're determined to make a real difference for Australia's first peoples. We encourage all interested applicants to apply. We're keen to support you with the next step in your career.
 APPLY NOW to live your best life and do your best work with us!
 If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
 We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696. 
Advertising End Date: 27/11/2026

title: Broadcast Designer
description:
Why join us? 
 Seven Media Group (SMG) is one of Australia’s most prominent media companies, with a market-leading presence across television, audio, publishing and digital. 
 Every day, millions of Australians turn to us for the news they rely on, the sport they love, the entertainment they enjoy and the stories that bring communities together. 
 SMG is home to some of Australia's most trusted and loved brands including the Seven Network, the Hit and Triple M radio networks and Australia’s number one podcast network, LiSTNR.
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity for a casual Broadcast Designer to join the Sydney News Graphics team servicing the News and Public Affairs programs.
 You’ll be reporting to the Network Art Director & Broadcast Graphics Manager and be based in our head office in Eveleigh, Sydney. 
 Please note that this is a casual position on a rotating roster, which may include early mornings, weekends, night shifts and public holidays, including Christmas and Good Friday. 
 What you'll do 
 Creating high-quality motion graphics and visual content across Sunrise, The Morning Show and 7NEWS bulletins. 
 Designing a wide range of on-air graphics, including story graphics, explainers, maps, studio screens and other broadcast graphics. 
 Working closely with editors, producers, journalists and the wider graphics team to turn editorial briefs into clear, engaging and visually strong graphics. 
 Working within established show branding and style guidelines while bringing creative ideas and solutions to each brief. 
 Managing multiple graphics requests and competing priorities while working to tight deadlines in a fast-paced, live news environment. 
 What will you need 
 You’re a results-driven person with the ability to build building positive relationships with our graphics team and show producers. You’re someone who thrives on organisation and excels at managing your time effectively, has a passion for creativity & innovation and a solid understanding of design principles. More specifically:
 Qualification(s) in graphic design, motion design, or related field. 
 2-5 years of professional experience in motion design. 
 Proficiency in industry-standard software such as Adobe Creative Suite. 
 3D Animation experience in Cinema 4D, Redshift (desirable). 
 Experience preparing design artwork for print production (desirable). 
 Working at SMG means being part of a business with unmatched reach, endless opportunities to grow, and the chance to make a real impact. Join us and shape the stories, experiences and conversations that connect Australia.
 SMG is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fair hiring. We welcome talent from all backgrounds and ensure a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. 
SMG is committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. If you require any accommodations during your interview, please let us know. We’re happy to support your needs to ensure a fair and comfortable experience. Reach out to careers@sevenmediagroup.com.au for assistance. #SNOL 
 Resumes from recruitment agencies will not be accepted.

title: CX Strategist
location: Melbourne, 161 Collins Street, Level 5; Brisbane, 10 Eagle Street
description:
Role Overview
 We’re seeking a Customer Strategy Manager to join the Marketing Advisory and Customer Technology team. This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role is responsible for shaping and delivering holistic customer strategies for growth accounts. You will bring vision and purpose to client and internal teams, coach and enable more junior team members, and apply strong business acumen to ensure work is both excellent and commercially viable. You’ll bring a problem-solving, creative mindset to every engagement, balancing a 360-degree focus on customer and business outcomes with measurable, results-oriented thinking.
 Key Responsibilities
 Solve client business problems through deep strategic experience and a human-centred design approach.
 Lead highly collaborative, client-facing engagements, including running meetings and workshops to align diverse stakeholder groups.
 Create high-quality baseline strategy artefacts that meet or exceed expected standards, such as roadmaps, performance reporting, research briefs and customer journey maps.
 Develop holistic, end-to-end strategies for growth accounts that can be delivered by delivery teams.
 Design, host and facilitate client workshops that translate ambiguity into clear direction.
 Build roadmaps in partnership with delivery managers and client stakeholders.
 Support sales as a Strategy subject matter expert on opportunities, applying strong business acumen to link strategy to commercial outcomes.
 Bring a creative, problem-solving mindset to engagements, thinking laterally and iteratively to open up new possibilities and value for clients
 Skills & Qualifications
 8+ years’ experience in a strategy role within an agency or consultancy environment.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, both internally and with clients.
 Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders within a business.
 Strong facilitation skills and the ability to problem-solve in real time, including in front of a room.
 Project management expertise: timelines, milestones, risk tracking, and deliverable ownership.
 Exposure to omnichannel orchestration and channel ROI analysis.
 Experience in competitive benchmarking and market insight generation.
 Knowledge of martech ecosystems and integration
 Tertiary qualifications in a related field.
 About Accenture 
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com

As part of our talent strategy, we hire and develop people who have different backgrounds, different perspectives and different lived experiences. These differences ensure that we have and attract the cognitive diversity to deliver a variety of perspectives, observations and insights which are essential to drive the innovation needed to reinvent, and we hold our leaders accountable for ensuring we have the most innovative and talented people in our industry.

title: Senior Experience Designer, Design System
description:
Create your best future and join Chief Data Office as a Senior Experience Designer. 
 What’s the role? 
 The Senior Experience Designer, Design Systems is responsible for evolving GEL as the foundation for consistent, accessible and high-quality digital experiences across Westpac. This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer with strong UI craft, systems thinking and native mobile experience. Working across iOS, Android and web, you'll design and document the foundations, components and patterns that enable product teams to build cohesive customer experiences at scale, balancing consistency with platform conventions so GEL feels distinctly Westpac while behaving naturally on each platform. The design system is also becoming the foundation for AI-assisted design and delivery. You'll help make GEL structured, documented and reliable enough that both people and AI tools can use it correctly, and you'll use AI in your own practice to work faster and to a higher standard.
 Key Responsibilities include: 
 Design and evolve the system - Build scalable Figma libraries using variables, modes, properties and clear component architecture. 
 Drive Quality, Accessibility and Consistency - Simplify the system by consolidating duplication and improving consistency across platforms. 
 Enable teams and AI-Assisted Delivery - Use AI across your own work - exploration, specification, documentation and QA - and share what works with the team. 
 Partner across Design and Engineering - Communicate design intent clearly through prototypes, specifications and direct collaboration. 
 What do I need? 
 To be successful in this role you will have substantial product, UI or interaction design experience, including operating at a senior designer level. You will also have demonstrated experience designing for native iOS and Android applications. You will bring a genuine enthusiasm for AI and how it changes design work, with evidence of using AI tools in your own practice and an appetite to push further. Strong communication and facilitation skills are necessary for this position, and you should have the ability to be able to explain design decisions and build alignment across disciplines. 
 Additional skills and experience required include: 
 Strong UI design skills, with excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour, hierarchy, interaction states and detail 
 Experience designing or making significant contributions to an established design system. 
 Advanced Figma capability, including components, variants, properties, variables, modes and library management. 
 Strong understanding of native mobile conventions, Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design. 
 A practical understanding of accessibility and inclusive design for mobile and web interfaces. 
 Why join us? 
 We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:
 Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
 Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave. 
 Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank. 
 Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.
 Create your future today 
 To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button 
 We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community. 
 If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find more information and contact details on our FAQs and how to contact us page , under the ‘Diversity, sustainability and flexibility’ section.
 We may close this job advertisement earlier than the advertised closing date if suitable candidates are identified. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Service Design Lead
description:
Create your best future and join as a Service Design Lead 
 Location: Sydney-based role only
 On-site Requirement: 2 - 3 days per week in the office
 Multiple opportunities are available.
 What’s the role? 
 As a Service Design Lead, you’ll shape future customer and banker experiences, turning strategic priorities into clear, customer-led plans. You’ll partner with Chief Product Owners and cross-functional teams, using customer insights, operational evidence and commercial data to identify problems, prioritise opportunities and influence delivery roadmaps.
 Additionally, you’ll lead end-to-end service design, customer and banker research, and workshops. You’ll create journey maps, service blueprints and insight reports that help teams make evidence-based decisions, improve customer experiences and address pain points at their root cause.
 You will work across Business, Analytics, Technology and Design to deliver simple, useful and responsible experiences. You’ll help embed compliance and responsible AI into service design, while strengthening design capability through reusable frameworks, tools and best practices that improve consistency, quality and speed across the organisation and support measurable customer and business outcomes.
 What do I need? 
 Extensive experience in strategic design, service design or experience design within banking and financial services, preferably across complex, multi-channel services. 
 Strong expertise in Human-Centred Design (HCD) and Design Thinking. 
 Advanced qualitative research skills, including uncovering unmet needs and testing hypotheses. 
 Ability to design and deliver effectively in complex and ambiguous environments. 
 Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with senior leaders and decisionmakers. 
 Experience leading design initiatives and multidisciplinary teams. 
 Proficiency in Askable, Miro, Figma and Microsoft 365, with Adobe Suite experience desirable.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
If you live in Australia or New Zealand, you’ve likely heard of AMP. But at a time when society is changing, we are too. We’re now a nimbler business with new leadership and thinking. 
 For us, these are exciting times. There’s a real potential for big thinkers to help us redefine what financial services could be. And turn our legacy into something even more positive and powerful for the future.
 Help people create their tomorrow, while you create yours
 We help people with their banking, super, retirement and finances. Through upturns, downturns, recessions, and major life transitions. Every day, we help people see and make more of their financial potential, so that they can create their tomorrow. And we’ve been doing it for over 170 years. 
 If we do our job well, we genuinely add to the prosperity of our country and its people. 
 How you’ll make an impact 
 As a Senior UX/UI Designer at North, you’ll take ownership of complex experiences used by financial advisers and their clients, helping shape how advice and wealth management work gets done digitally. You’ll work across products, journeys and squads, turning complex financial, regulatory and operational problems into experiences that feel simple, intuitive and considered.
 This is a role with genuine ownership. You’ll lead design from early discovery through to delivery, make experience decisions, challenge assumptions and work closely with Product, Technology and the broader business to shape the right outcomes. You’ll balance customer needs with commercial, technical, risk and regulatory realities, and have the judgement to know when to push, when to simplify and where design can make the biggest difference.
 You’ll also help us shape what good looks like at North. We’re continuing to evolve our digital experiences, design system and ways of working, so you’ll have the opportunity to influence not just the product you work on, but how we design across North more broadly. That includes working collaboratively with other designers, strengthening our craft and helping us build a more consistent, connected experience across the ecosystem. 
 What you will bring to the role 
 You’re an experienced designer who is comfortable taking a complex problem and owning the experience through to a high-quality outcome. You combine strong UX thinking with equally strong UI craft, and can move confidently between understanding the problem, exploring and testing ideas, and working with engineers to get the details right in production.
 You’ll be comfortable working in ambiguity and navigating the realities of a complex business. You can bring structure to messy problems, use research and evidence to make decisions, explain the thinking behind your work and influence people with different perspectives. Experience in Wealth, Superannuation, Investments or Financial Services will help, but just as important is your ability to quickly understand complex domains and make them feel simple for the people using them.
 We’re looking for someone with strong capability across interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, user research, usability testing and visual design, with advanced Figma skills and experience working with design systems. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should understand how digital products are built and be able to work closely with technology teams to turn strong design intent into strong shipped experiences.
 You’ll thrive here if… 
 If you can adapt from BAU to the ambiguous with ease, you’ll do well here. Change is never easy, so bring your commitment, grit and growth mindset.
 Because we run lean, you’ll be expected to jump in and deliver across a variety of areas. Meaning, you’ll be closer to the action and executive decisions that influence where we go next.
 If you’re someone that can hold their own, you’ll find AMP quite liberating. 
 Why we think you’ll love working at AMP
 Doing what we’ve always done is not an option, so your clever ideas will get airtime here. You’ll be encouraged to speak up and try new things. If they don’t work, we move on – better for it.
 We know there’s no one way of doing things. So, you won’t have to sacrifice who you are or how you work to fit in here. We’re inclusive and flexible in many of the ways you’d expect. And in some of the ways you wouldn’t. As long as your health and wellbeing come first - at home and at work. 
 In fact, most of what makes AMP such a welcoming, enjoyable place to work are our people. Wherever you go, you’ll find moments to connect, feel valued and do meaningful work. 
 Whether it’s through our first-class leaders who are invested in you and your success. Through year-round opportunities to volunteer, fundraise and give back to the community. Or in the everyday challenges you face as we work together to strengthen this great organisation. Challenges that will stretch you, amplify your potential and compound the impact you have. 
 We believe in the power of inclusion and diversity 
 We’re dedicated to fostering inclusion, diversity, and a warm feeling of belonging at AMP. It sparks creativity, ignites innovation, and turns up the dial on the quality of our decisions and performance. This not only makes our workplace more engaged, but also leads to better connections with our customers. 
 We're your allies in the search for the perfect fit - when you apply, let us know how we can support you to put your best self forward during our selection process. 
 We're also committed to enhancing employment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, so we enthusiastically encourage candidates from these backgrounds to apply and explore our Reconciliation Plan on our website
 Ready to create your tomorrow? 
 If you’re someone who sees opportunity where others see challenge, come and work with us in smart, progressive ways as we transform an iconic Australian brand for the future. And, through a series of career-defining moments, create your own tomorrow.
 Don’t procrastinate! We review applications when we get them, and if we discover the ideal candidate, we may close the role earlier than the advertised close date

title: Customer Listening Specialist
description:
We’re all about helping our members make the most of their money. And while they go after their goals, you can too. As a Customer Listening Specialist, you'll be responsible for gathering, analysing and interpreting customer feedback to generate insights that support data-informed decision making and improved customer experiences.
 You'll work across a broad range of feedback channels, including surveys, complaints, call transcripts, digital interactions and operational data, helping the business understand what's working well and where opportunities exist. Partnering with teams across ART, you'll champion the voice of the customer and help drive actions that improve member outcomes.
You'll also contribute to the ongoing evolution of ART's Voice of Customer program, supporting enhancements to tools, reporting, processes and stakeholder capability while helping embed a customer-centric mindset across the organisation.
 This role is a 12-month max-term opportunity and is based in Brisbane, with an anticipated commencement date of February 2027. Manage and deliver a portfolio within ART's Voice of Customer program across key customer journeys and interactions.
 Design, manage and coordinate customer surveys from questionnaire development through to reporting and insight delivery.
 Analyse and triangulate structured and unstructured customer feedback data to identify trends, pain points and opportunities.
 Build and maintain dashboards, reports and presentations that turn data into meaningful business recommendations.
 Partner with stakeholders across the business to drive action from customer insights and support continuous improvement initiatives.
 Support closed-loop feedback processes to ensure customer issues are understood and addressed.
 Develop training materials and facilitate sessions that build understanding and adoption of the Voice of Customer program.
 Contribute to broader transformation initiatives and continuous improvement activities. It goes without saying you'll be a great communicator with top notch interpersonal skills. We'll also expect you to pick up problems and come up with quick, creative ways to solve them. It's quite likely you tick some of the following boxes too:
 You have experience managing and working across Voice of Customer programs.
 Your ability to gather, analyse and synthesise customer feedback enables you to develop actionable recommendations.
 You'll have hands-on experience designing surveys and working with Qualtrics or similar customer feedback platforms.
 You're comfortable presenting insights and influencing stakeholders through compelling data storytelling.
 You have strong stakeholder management skills and enjoy building trusted working relationships.
 Your experience includes working with structured and unstructured data sources to uncover meaningful customer insights.
 You'll bring strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
 You're experienced working within regulated environments such as financial services, superannuation or similar industries.

title: Digital Designer - Upstate Sport
description:
ABOUT US 
Bleacher Athletic is the sports division of Cotton On Group, creating licensed apparel and fanwear across the AFL, AFLW and NRL.
 Alongside this, we are the team behind Upstate Sport - a fast-growing women’s activewear brand born in the studio and built for real life. Designed to move seamlessly from workout to everyday wear, Upstate Sport blends performance, style and community.
 With exciting growth plans ahead, this is an opportunity to join the brand at a pivotal stage and help shape what’s next.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
Upstate Sport is looking for a part-time (3 days per week) Digital Designer with a strong social-first mindset to help bring the brand to life.
 This newly created role is ideal for someone who understands how to design content that cuts through - balancing strong brand aesthetics with engaging, performance-led creative. Working within a small and fast-moving team, you’ll create digital assets across social, ecommerce, paid media, EDM and campaign moments that feel elevated, relevant and built for modern platforms.
 You’ll play a key role in shaping how the brand shows up digitally, creating content that drives engagement, brand awareness and commercial performance.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Design engaging, social-first creative across Instagram, TikTok, paid social, ecommerce and EDM
 Create digital assets for campaigns, launches, brand moments and always-on content
 Translate briefs into compelling and on-brand creative concepts
 Ensure all creative feels elevated, cohesive and aligned to the Upstate Sport visual identity
 Design content with a strong understanding of social trends, digital behaviour and platform best practice
 Continuously explore new creative trends, formats and ideas to keep the brand visually relevant and engaging
 WHO YOU ARE 
 Strong understanding of digital design, social content and visual storytelling
 You understand what makes people stop scrolling
 Creative, proactive and highly organised with strong attention to detail
 Strong design eye with the ability to balance brand and performance
 Comfortable working across both campaign creative and day-to-day content execution
 Collaborative, adaptable and confident working within a smaller team environment
 You're passionate about wellness, movement and digital culture 
 OUR CULTURE 
 We love big ideas and rolling up our sleeves to get the job done. We work hard – and together, we do great stuff. We’ve created an environment that thrives on creativity and self-expression, an environment we love showing up to. Every day.
 Right from the get-go, our team have been like great mates to us – and you look after your mates, always. So, we care for our people at work and at home; 24/7. We’re all about supporting and empowering them to be the healthiest versions of themselves.
 BENEFITS 
Competitive salary 
 Flexible working options & people-first leave initiatives 
 Access to our world-class Support Centre, with an in-house restaurant & state-of-the-art wellness centre featuring free gym & holistic health services 
 Subsidised onsite childcare centre 
 50% off our Brands | Cotton On, Cotton On Body, Cotton On Kids, Rubi Shoes, Typo, Factorie & Supre 
 24/7 Wellness support – mental health, relationships, family + more 
 Local & Global career growth 
 Discounts for you & your family – medical, travel, financial + more 
 Performance & Peak incentives to reward + recognise our team 
 Returnity - Paid program for new parents heading back to work 
 Bring your dog to work 
 Recognition, team connection moments & more! 
 We are proud of our diverse global workforce of 20,000 team members from countless nationalities, and we strongly welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply with us. 
 We are focused on bringing more voices, experiences and backgrounds to our workforce as we drive diverse and inclusive outcomes for our team and our customers. 
 If you have any individual needs in order to fully participate in the recruitment process, please contact us at recruitment@cottonon.com.au so we may support you in completing the job application process.

title: Product Designer
description:
Brighter Futures Start Here 
 We are an inclusive team who power two of the most iconic and loved brands, Kmart and Target. We have more than 50,000 passionate individuals across our stores, distribution centres, and offices around the globe. 
With our brands touching the lives of almost two million customers every week, you’ll feel the impact of the work you’ll do every day. As a leader in the retail market, we’re optimistic about our future and yours. We’re changing at a rapid rate, giving you challenging work that you’ll be proud of. 
 Join the team
 We have an exciting opportunity for a Product Designer to join our team and help shape digital products and experiences used by millions of customers. You’ll work on meaningful customer and business problems, using design thinking, research, data and experimentation to create experiences that are useful, intuitive and impactful. 
 Working closely with Product, Engineering and other stakeholders across Kmart Group, you’ll contribute throughout the product lifecycle — from understanding and framing problems through to designing, shipping, measuring and continuously improving experiences. We’re looking for someone who is curious, proactive and eager to solve problems. You’ll be comfortable navigating ambiguity and change, keen to learn and grow, and motivated by turning complex challenges into simple, effective experiences. 
 What you’ll be doing 
 As a Product Designer working for Kmart you will: 
 Support product strategy by translating customer needs, business objectives and insights into thoughtful design solutions 
 Take ownership of design within your product area, working with your product team from discovery and concept development through delivery, measurement and iteration 
 Partner closely with Product and Engineering, as well as Analytics, Trade, Marketing, SEO and other stakeholders, to identify opportunities and deliver customer and business outcomes 
 Balance customer needs, business goals and technical feasibility to create practical and scalable design solutions 
 Use customer research, behavioural data, market insights and experimentation to inform design decisions, evaluate outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement 
 Plan and conduct appropriate customer research and usability testing, and translate insights into actionable product decisions 
 Apply strong UX, UI and interaction design principles, using user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes to explore, communicate and validate solutions 
 Contribute to and apply the Kmart Group design system, helping create consistent, accessible and scalable digital experiences 
 Apply accessibility and inclusive design principles to create experiences that work for the diverse communities we serve 
 Keep up to date with industry best practices, emerging trends and new approaches to design, bringing relevant ideas and learnings into the team 
 Participate in design critique and peer review, giving and receiving constructive feedback to continuously improve the quality of our work 
 Share insights, learnings and knowledge with others, contributing to the growth and continuous improvement of Kmart Group’s product design practice 
 To be successful in this role you’ll have:
 3+ years' experience in a product design role, designing and shipping digital products and experiences that solve real customer problems 
 A portfolio that demonstrates your design process, problem-solving approach and contribution to shipped product outcomes 
 An appreciation of the end-to-end product development process, from discovery and problem framing through to detailed UX, UI and interaction design 
 Strong product thinking and an ability to balance customer needs, business outcomes and technical constraints 
 Experience creating user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes using modern design tools such as Figma, with app-native design experience highly regarded 
 An understanding of component-based design systems and how they enable consistent experiences at scale 
 A solid understanding of user-centred design principles and experience conducting or applying customer research 
 The ability to clearly communicate design rationale and make design problems understandable to people from different disciplines and levels of the organisation 
 Experience working cross-functionally with a collaborative approach and the ability to build strong working relationships with Product, Engineering and other business stakeholders 
 A proactive and problem-solving mindset, with the confidence to identify opportunities, ask questions and take action to move work forward 
 Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity, with the ability to adjust your approach as priorities, customer needs and business challenges evolve in a fast-paced environment 
 Curiosity and a growth mindset, with a genuine eagerness to learn, seek feedback, develop your craft and continuously improve 
 The ability to work independently within your area of responsibility while knowing when to seek guidance, collaborate and bring others along 
 A willingness to contribute to the broader design team and share knowledge with others 
Benefits we’ll offer you: 
 Flexible hybrid working options through our Flex Where, Flex When, Flex Well policy. 
 A team member discount card that gives you a discount at Kmart, Target, Officeworks and Bunnings 
 Access to the Brighter Benefits program which entitles you to exclusive discounts and benefits in the areas of entertainment, travel, lifestyle, and health – with over 60 suppliers! 
 We want you to feel rewarded for your commitment and hard work that's why eligible team members get the opportunity to participate in a bonus program 
 We offer inclusive parental leave, and ongoing support offered through our partnership with Circle In for team members of all backgrounds and family circumstances 
 A dynamic learning and support program 
 Opportunity to fast track your career through our Mentor Program as a Mentee or Mentor 
 A Kudos recognition program, where you are nominated by your peers to spin a wheel, to win a stack of cool prizes 
 Great career opportunities across the broader Wesfarmers Group 
We celebrate the rich diversity of the communities in which we operate. We are committed to creating inclusive and safe environments where all our team members can contribute and succeed. We believe that all team members should feel valued, respected and safe, and strive to ensure our recruitment process is accessible and welcoming, with applications encouraged from all candidates.
 We encourage you to tell us about any workplace adjustments that you would like, by emailing kmartgroupcareers@kmart.com.au.
 If you would like to explore a career with Kmart and this sounds like the perfect role for you – apply now!

title: UX Designer
description:
At Metcash, you’re part of something bigger. We’ve got the heart of a small business with the strength and support of a big business. 
 When you join Metcash, your work makes a real difference to independent businesses and local communities, empowering you to: 
 Grow your career with tailored development programs 
 Thrive your way with flexible work options 
 Make your mark in a high-performing, values-led team 
At Metcash Food, we’re the power behind local business, proudly supplying over 1600 independently owned stores in every corner of Australia and New Zealand. With a range of trusted independent brands like IGA, Foodland and Campbells/C-Store, our stores sit at the heart of their communities, providing locals with the products and homegrown produce they love most. 
 We're looking for a UX Designer to help shape intuitive, user-centred digital experiences across IGA Australia's digital platforms. Working closely with product, technology and business teams, you'll transform customer insights into engaging user journeys, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. 
 If you're passionate about creating seamless digital experiences and thrive in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you! 
 In this Role 
 Design intuitive, user-centred digital experiences that improve customer engagement and usability 
 Create user journeys, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes 
 Conduct user research and usability testing to uncover insights and drive design decisions 
 Evolve and maintain the IGA design system, component library and UI standards 
 Partner with Product, Technology and Business teams to translate ideas into exceptional digital experiences 
 Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure design quality is maintained through delivery 
 Present design concepts and recommendations to stakeholders, clearly articulating the value behind your solutions 
 You’re Likely a Match If: 
 Strong experience with Figma, including prototyping and working within design systems 
 Proven ability to conduct user research and translate insights into meaningful design solutions 
 Excellent UX and UI design skills, with a keen eye for visual design, layout and interaction 
 Experience creating wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs and prototypes 
 Solid understanding of design systems, component libraries and digital best practices 
 Confidence presenting and articulating design decisions to stakeholders and cross-functional teams 
 A proactive, collaborative approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment 
 What’s on offer 
 We’re proud to offer a workplace that supports your well-being, growth, and belonging: 
 🏖️ Extra Leave: Enjoy a 5th week of annual leave, 2 well-being days, plus 1 volunteer day annually 
 📚 Career Growth: Endless learning and development opportunities 
 👶 Parental Leave: 12 weeks of gender-neutral paid leave for primary carers 
 🌈 Inclusive Culture: Bronze Employer for LGBTQ Inclusion 
 ⚖️ Neutral Pay Gap: Gender pay gap under 5% (WGEA 2024–2025) 
 🧠 Mental Health: Gold accreditation by Mental Health Australia 
 🏡 Flexibility: Flex Ready and Family Friendly Workplace accredited 
 About Us 
 Join us and be part of something bigger! 
 Metcash is Australia’s leading wholesale distribution company, with $19.5 billion in sales (FY26) and a proud spot in the ASX Top 125. 
 We believe in the power of independent, family-owned businesses to shape vibrant communities. Through our food, liquor, and hardware pillars, we help retailers become the ‘Best Store in Their Town’ by providing merchandising, operational and marketing support. 
 We’re committed to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability — and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including First Nations. If you need support during the application process, just let us know. Your privacy and dignity are always respected. 
 This role is being managed directly by our internal Talent Acquisition team. We respectfully request that recruitment agencies do not submit profiles or make contact regarding this opportunity.

title: Principal Human Centred Design | Australia
description:
About BHP 
 At BHP we support our people to grow, learn, develop their skills and reach their potential. With a global portfolio of operations, we offer a diverse and inclusive environment with extraordinary career opportunities. Our strategy is to focus on creating a safe work environment where our employees feel strongly connected to our values and objectives, and where the capability of our people is key to our success.
 Come and be a part of this success.
 About the Role 
 Reporting to the Manager Experience Delivery, this role brings human-centred and service design expertise to Portfolio & Experience (P&E) initiatives. You will make sure material HR change is designed around the real needs of employees and leaders, not just internal process, by applying human-centred design methods and leading service design and experience mapping. 
 Accountabilities 
 Applies human-centred design methods to P&E initiatives   
 Leads service design and experience mapping for material change   
 Facilitates design workshops with employees, leaders and stakeholders   
 Translates customer insight into practical design recommendations   
 Partners with Principal Project Management and Lead Principal for a Value Stream on delivery integration   
 Supports usability and experience testing of new solutions   
 Contributes to P&E's design standards and toolkits   
 Reports design outcomes and insights to Manager Experience Delivery   
 About You 
 Tertiary qualification in design, organizational psychology, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience 
 Postgraduate study or certification in human-centred design, service design or design thinking is preferred 
 Proven experience applying human-centred and service design methods, including user research, journey and experience mapping, service blueprinting and co-design, to complex organisational change 
 Demonstrated ability to translate customer and employee insight into clear, practical design recommendations that leaders can act on 
 Strong facilitation skills, with experience running design workshops with employees, leaders and other stakeholders 
 Experience planning and running usability and experience testing of new solutions, and using the findings to refine them 
 Ability to work alongside project management and delivery teams so that design outcomes are built into delivery 
 Experience building design standards, toolkits or practices that other teams can use, and a strong portfolio of work that shows your approach and impact 
 Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to share insights and design outcomes clearly with senior stakeholders 
 Experience in HR, people or employee experience design is preferred but not essential 
 About Our Process 
 At BHP, we are committed to employing individuals who align with the BHP Charter Values and meet the requirements of the role. As part of the recruitment process, there are a number of checks which may be conducted to demonstrate applicants suitability for a role including police / criminal background checks, medical, drug and alcohol testing, due diligence checks, right to work checks, and/or reference checks. 
 If you are already employed directly by BHP, please log in using your BHP email address or apply via our internal jobs portal. 
 Supporting a Diverse Workforce 
 The size, stability and magnitude of our business not only provides significant opportunity for professional development, but also attractive salary packages with performance-based bonuses and a best-in-class employee share program. We know there are many aspects of our employees' lives that are important, and work is only one of these, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, other extended leave entitlements and parent rooms.  
 At BHP, we know that we are strengthened by diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity employer that is committed to making BHP a safe and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and be at their best every day. We are focused on creating a workforce that’s more diverse and represents the communities where we work and live. providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and recognise that true diversity includes gender, age, race, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, education levels, and many more aspects of your identity.
 BHP is committed to providing a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and accessible for all. If you have a disability, we know that it may be helpful for us to adjust our process to make it equitable for your individual situation. If you would like to reach out to someone about your situation and our recruitment process, please email us at inclusion@bhp.com .

title: First Nations CX Lead - Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane
description:
About Us 
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers. 
 About the Role 
 The First Nations Customer Experience Lead will drive meaningful improvements in the experience and outcomes of First Nations Retail customers by removing barriers to access, strengthening trust, and enabling culturally appropriate banking solutions.
 This includes leading initiatives that improve financial access for customers in remote and regional communities, ensuring services are inclusive, practical, and responsive to community needs.
 A key focus is partnering across Customer Proposition, frontline banking teams, and support functions to design and implement accessible service models (including remote servicing solutions), enhance customer journeys, and build capability that reflects strong cultural intelligence. 
 The role also works closely with the First Nations Strategy Office and Customer Advocate to ensure customer voices inform decisions and that outcomes align with First Nations priorities for success.
 This is a special measures role, in accordance with equal opportunity/anti-discrimination legislation, where applicable. In locations where this does not apply, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates are encouraged to apply. 
 This role requires a deep understanding of First Nations cultures, strong relationship-building skills, and a commitment to driving positive outcomes for First Nations customers. 
 Role Type: Permanent 
 Role Location: Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane (other locations to be considered)
 Work Hours: Full time
 What will your day look like? 
 Delivering measurable customer outcomes 
Translate strategy into tangible improvements in financial inclusion, financial wellbeing, and customer experience, tracking and delivering against clear outcome-based metrics.
 Customer-led solution design 
Use data, insights, and direct community engagement to understand barriers and co-design solutions that reflect the lived experience and priorities of First Nations customers.
 Risk management and safe delivery 
Identify, assess, and manage risks associated with service delivery and access solutions, ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations and embedding culturally informed, safe, and responsible banking practices for First Nations customers.
 Influence access to banking services 
Advocate for and shape practical, culturally appropriate solutions that improve access for First Nations retail customers, particularly in remote and regional communities (e.g. alternative servicing models, digital and assisted channels), by working across teams and stakeholders to drive aligned outcomes.
 Embed advocacy and continuous improvement 
Champion the voice of First Nations customers across the organisation, working with the Customer Advocate Office and broader value chain to identify systemic barriers, influence change, and continuously improve customer journeys.
 Build trusted relationships and partnerships 
Develop and maintain strong relationships with First Nations communities, stakeholders, and internal partners to enable trust, collaboration, and shared value outcomes.
 Strengthen frontline capability and cultural intelligence 
Partner with Customer Engagement and First Nations Strategy Office teams to uplift cultural capability, ensuring bankers are equipped to provide respectful, informed, and effective service to First Nations customers.
 What will you bring? 
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
 Strong expertise in change management + project delivery principles
 Experience in building positive and trusted relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders, especially with First Nations communities and organisations.
 Outstanding cultural awareness and capability, including strong knowledge of Australian First Nations histories, cultures and communities.
 Passion for improving First Nations financial empowerment and self-determination.
 A strong sense of accountability, and track record of following through on commitments within set timeframes and to agreed standards.
 Effective communication skills including interpersonal, writing and presentation; ability to adapt communication styles to suit a wide range of stakeholders.
 Planning and prioritisation to identify and sequence required activities. Able to navigate multiple and competing priorities.
 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you. 
 So why join us? 
 From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive. 
 But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. You'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career. 
 We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more. 
 At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and encourage you to talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you're a candidate with a disability or access requirement, and have an enquiry about the support provided, please let us know on your application or visit ANZ Accessibility and Inclusion Programs for alternate contact methods. 
 To find out more about working at ANZ, visit https://www.anz.com.au/careers . You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 127473 . 
 Job Posting End Date 
 03/12/2026, 11.59pm, (Melbourne Australia)

title: Senior Retail Designer
description:
Shape customer-focused retail environments that elevate brand experience and support business growth nationwide.
Your opportunity 
 As Senior Retail Designer, you'll play a key role in how customers connect with our brands across a national retail network. Sitting at the intersection of design, customer experience and commercial performance, this is an opportunity to influence environments that are both visually engaging and purposefully designed. If you're passionate about creating spaces that leave a lasting impression, you'll find plenty of scope to make your mark here.
 Your role 
 Reporting to the Retail Operations & Capability Manager, you’ll lead the end-to-end design journey for retail and corporate environments. Your work will influence customer experience, brand presence and the success of projects delivered across Tabcorp’s national footprint. 
 Lead retail and corporate design projects from concept to completion 
 Create customer-focused environments aligned to brand objectives 
 Develop layouts, visualisations and detailed design documentation 
 Partner with stakeholders, suppliers and project delivery teams 
 Review sites and refine designs for practical implementation 
 Drive innovation and continuous improvement across retail environments 
 Your game changing qualities 
 You’re a creative and commercially minded designer who enjoys turning ideas into real-world spaces. You balance design excellence with practicality and build strong relationships across diverse stakeholders. 
 Qualified in Interior Design, Architecture or related discipline 
 Experienced designing commercial or retail environments 
 Strong capability using ArchiCAD, AutoCAD and Adobe Creative Suite 
 Ability to develop concepts through detailed documentation

 Perks that make a difference 
 We know that when we belong, we thrive. That’s why we offer:

 Ticketing to some of the country’s biggest racing and sports events. 
 Access to our leading wellbeing app and programs to help you be your best

 A diverse and inclusive culture where everyone belongs 
 Get to know us 
 We’re Tabcorp - home to TAB, Sky Racing, and MAX, shaping the future of our industry through digital innovation and cutting-edge technology. With a strong retail presence and a growing digital footprint, we connect customers wherever they play. We’re innovators and big thinkers in a fast-paced, exciting sector, committed to safer gambling and responsible play. Here, you’ll belong where the action is and make Tabcorp your home ground.
 Make your move 
 Ready to make Tabcorp your home ground? Join a team that thrives on collaboration, inclusion, respect, and face to face connection. If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, please visit our How We Hire page for support and contact details: www.tabcorp.com.au/careers/how-we-hire.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers 
 A fantastic opportunity to design and deliver world class digital products 
 Full-time permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide 
 Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.
 As the Product Designer , you will own the end-to-end design and delivery of digital product experiences for a defined product area, journey stage, or capability. You will translate ambiguous customer and business problems into clear experience outcomes, design approaches and build-ready solutions that improve customer experience and business value.
 Operating across discovery through to delivery and continuous iteration, you will independently plan and run research, frame problems, explore solution options and partner closely with Product and Engineering to deliver outcomes. You will work autonomously on complex initiatives and may lead design for a workstream within larger programs, maintaining alignment to the overarching design strategy set by senior design leadership.
 This is a mid-level role, suited to an experienced designer who is confident owning their work from problem framing through to release with minimal day-to-day direction, and who wants to keep growing their craft alongside senior designers.
 To be successful in this role, you will be a strong collaborator and influencer within your squad and immediate stakeholder group. You will facilitate workshops to align teams, contribute to design system adoption and improvement, and ensure solutions meet brand, accessibility, and quality standards. You will use AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of design activities such as insight synthesis, exploration, prototyping and handover.
 You’ll have: 
 4+ years of experience in Product Design, UX, UI, Service Design and/or a similar role, with a track record of owning design work end-to-end in a delivery environment.
 Tertiary qualification in Design, Human-Centred Design (HCD), or a relevant field.
 A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end work you have owned, showing your process from problem framing and research through to shipped outcomes.
 Experience independently planning and running research and usability testing, and turning insights into clear problem statements, personas, journey maps and user stories.
 Proven capability in concept development and interaction design, taking ideas from sketches and wireframes through to high-fidelity, build-ready UI.
 Proven capability creating interactive prototypes, from rapid low-fidelity concepts through to high-fidelity prototypes for user testing and stakeholder alignment.
 Experience designing for native apps, responsive web, conversational interfaces and other digital platforms.
 Experience working with and contributing to a design system, applying components and patterns consistently and creating or proposing new UI patterns where needed.
 Experience preparing clear developer handover (specifications, annotations, states and edge cases), supporting engineers through build and completing design QA before release.
 Working knowledge of usability and accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, applied throughout your design work.
 Experience using data to inform design decisions, including analytics, experimentation (such as A/B testing) and usability measures.
 Ability to balance user needs, business objectives and technical constraints, delivering outcomes aligned with the brief, brand and business requirements.
 Experience working within modern frameworks and rituals: Lean, Design Thinking, Scrum, Kanban.
 Proficiency in modern industry tools such as Figma, Miro and Adobe Creative Suite, and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
 Practical experience using AI tools to support design work such as insight synthesis, exploration, rapid prototyping and developer handover (e.g. Figma’s AI features, Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor).
 Facilitation skills that include experience running workshops that lead to clear, agreed outcomes.
 Ability to communicate and adapt presentation of design concepts and decisioning to stakeholders at all levels.
 Demonstrated knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.
 Why Qantas? 
 At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.  
 You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 
 And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.
